faq.q: Do I need to book a cellar-door tasting?
faq.a: It depends on the venue and the tasting. Montalto welcomes walk-ins, Crittenden highly prefers bookings, and Paringa recommends them. A restaurant reservation is separate from a tasting. Use each producer's visit link to confirm your date and group size.

faq.q: How many wineries should I plan for one day?
faq.a: Start with one tasting and a lunch, then add a second stop only if your bookings and transport allow it. This is a planning suggestion, not a timed driving itinerary. Arrange a designated driver or suitable transport before tasting.

faq.q: Can I assume a winery welcomes visitors?
faq.a: No. A wine producer may sell bottles without offering public tastings. This selection includes venues with an operator-published cellar door. For access needs, children, dogs or larger groups, ask the venue before booking; those policies are not verified here.
